passages.provision_quote: The hourly minimum wage for fast food restaurant employees shall be twenty dollars ($20) per hour, effective April 1, 2024.
passages.note: Sets a fast-food-only $20/hour floor with Council-set annual increases; sector-specific, so it cannot show her general wage-floor rule (annex hard case).

rows.reasoning: Wicks voted Aye on AB 1228 (2023-2024), which sets a $20/hour minimum wage for fast food restaurant employees only, with later increases set by the Fast Food Council. Per the annex's sector/employer-group hard case, a one-industry wage floor is on the wage-floor question but does not show her general rule, so it stays direction-only rather than establishing any numbered rung.
